e2e_edge_case_lookup_failure_full_vin_then_claim

No PhoneNumber in input variables. Agent asks the customer for the phone number tied to their contract — customer says they don't remember it. Agent asks for a manual identifier. Customer provides full 17-character VIN — agent accepts it without asking the customer to repeat just the last 8 characters, then calls get_contract_and_claims_data_ivr with the VIN — that lookup fails. Agent reads back the VIN and asks the customer to correct it or provide a different identifier. Customer provides claim number. Agent calls get_contract_and_claims_data_ivr with the claim number — that also fails. Agent escalates via Unified Escalation Protocol after two failed identifier attempts.

  • When the agent asks whether you are a Contract Holder, Dealership, or Assurant Employee, say you are a Contract Holder

  • When the agent asks for a contract number, claim number, or VIN, provide your full 17-character VIN '1HGCV1F30ZA999033'
  • If the agent asks what type of number that is, say it is your VIN
  • If the first lookup fails and the agent asks for a different identifier, provide your claim number '99999033'
